CONSENT CALENDAR
Approve an eight-year lease to the County of San Mateo to use approximately 40,000 square feet of an SFPUC Parcel located on the north peak of Montara Mountain for a communications facility
Accept work performed by A. Ruiz Construction Co. & Assoc., Inc., for San Francisco Local Water As-Needed Paving; approve increasing the contract for a total contract amount of $22,940,706.

Approve an increase of $101,000 and of approximately two years to the contract duration and cost contingency for 525 Golden Gate Avenue As-Needed Mechanical Systems Inspection, Maintenance, and Repairs
Approve the First Amendment for the continued use by the SFPUC Water Enterprise City Distribution Division of a warehouse and offices at 1980 Oakdale Avenue in San Francisco
Adopt revised San Francisco Public Utilities Commission’s Fund Balance Reserve Policy incorporating a CleanPowerSF Fund Balance Reserve and replace the existing CleanPowerSF Reserves Policy.

Public Hearing and possible action to approve the scope, schedule, and budget of the March 2022 Proposed Revised Water System Improvement Program; and direct staff to send a Notice of Change Report to the State Water Resources Control Board and the Alfred E. Alquist Seismic Safety Commission in compliance with California Water Code Section 73500 et seq.
